scope: DSIR Article III resource-route equivalence support only
purpose: Prospectively test whether the frozen canonical 8193 requested-k response can be reproduced by contiguous low-capacity CLASS chunks, before any 32769 chunked route is considered.

interpretation.pass_means: The tested 8193 response is numerically equivalent under the frozen 1e-12 support tolerance when requested monolithically versus four contiguous low-capacity chunks.
interpretation.pass_does_not_mean: 32769 chunking is authorized, 32769 convergence is established, or the scientific frontier changes.
interpretation.failure_means: Chunked requesting is not yet qualified as a resource-equivalent route under this frozen test; failure is support/resource-method evidence, not a DSIR physical-model failure.

forbidden: No change to canonical nodes, CLASS commit, H, native k-per-decade, baseline, precision or role tuples.
No covariance, whitening, nuisance, relation/null or Wm_S3 access.
No 32769 chunked execution from this contract alone.
